workspace.export.failed: The export failed. Nothing was written.
workspace.alias.removeFailed: The alias could not be removed. Nothing was changed.
workspace.alias.createFailed: The alias could not be created. Nothing was changed.
workspace.alias.reason.name: The name is empty or longer than {max} characters.
workspace.alias.reason.target: The board name is empty or longer than {max} characters.
workspace.alias.reason.same: The schematic and board names must differ.
workspace.alias.reason.limit: At most {max} aliases fit in one workspace.
workspace.emptyPane: Nothing to show here yet. Attach a document or pick one above.
exportDialog.title: Export workspace
exportDialog.intro: Choose exactly what goes into the bundle. Nothing is included unless it is ticked here; the originals are never modified.
exportDialog.boardHint: The board file may be private or proprietary. Leave it out when you share the bundle.
exportDialog.notesHint: Technician notes and measurements of this board.
exportDialog.nothing: Tick at least one item to export.
exportDialog.sessionOnly: Browser mode: the workspace is not saved. The export reads what is in memory right now.
linkDialog.title: Board and schematic link
linkDialog.intro: Names that differ between the board and the schematic are never linked on a guess. Create an alias only when you know that two names are the same thing; each one can be removed again and applies to this board only.
linkDialog.persisted: Aliases are saved with this board's workspace. The board and schematic files are never modified.
linkDialog.sessionOnly: Browser mode: nothing is saved. Aliases work until this page is closed.
linkDialog.noLink: No schematic is attached and ready, so there is nothing to compare. Attach a schematic in the Documents tab.
linkDialog.refsHint: A schematic reference such as "U1A" that has no board component of that name can be linked to one board reference.
linkDialog.caseFlag: differs only in letter case: confirm it is the same part
linkDialog.alreadyAliased: already has an alias: creating a new one replaces it
linkDialog.refConsequence: Consequence: schematic reference "{source}" will be treated as board reference "{target}" in cross-probing, search and the pin comparison (pins are matched by number). Nothing is renamed in either file.
linkDialog.noSchOnlyRefs: Every schematic reference has a board counterpart.
linkDialog.netsHint: Net names are never merged by similarity. Confirm a schematic net name and a board net name as the same net.
linkDialog.netConsequence: Consequence: schematic net "{source}" will be treated as the same net as board net "{target}": the net comparison marks it as confirmed and selecting one side selects the other. Pins are not changed.
linkDialog.noNetCandidates: No schematic net names without a board counterpart.
linkDialog.fromComparison: Seen in the comparison (choose to review, nothing is applied):
linkDialog.diffCaption: Schematic net → board net, as seen on the compared pins. Review pre-fills the form; nothing is applied until you create the alias.
linkDialog.noDiff: No pin or net differences are listed.
linkDialog.removeHint: Removing an alias only unlinks the two names again; documents, notes and files are untouched.
linkDialog.issueSourceRef: The schematic has no reference "{name}" any more
linkDialog.issueSourceNet: The schematic has no net "{name}" any more
linkDialog.issueTargetRef: The board has no reference "{name}" any more
linkDialog.issueTargetNet: The board has no net "{name}" any more
linkDialog.truncated: The list was truncated by its limit; the comparison is still complete for the counts above.
linkDialog.toastSame: An alias must map a name to a different name.
linkDialog.toastLimitRefs: At most {max} refs aliases fit in one workspace.
linkDialog.toastLimitNets: At most {max} nets aliases fit in one workspace.
linkDialog.toastFailed: The change could not be applied.
workspace.dropDocumentsHint: Documents are attached to this board. Board files open as a new board.
workspace.splitDivider: Resize the board and document panes
workspace.splitHint: Drag, or use the arrow keys. Double-click to reset.
workspace.noProblems: No parser or connectivity problems reported.
workspace.unresolvedSheets: Sheet files that could not be read
workspace.unresolvedSheetsHint: Their content is not shown and not part of the connectivity. Put the file in the same folder as the schematic and attach it again.
workspace.linkPanelHint: Compare the board with this schematic and confirm aliases for names that differ
workspace.noSchematicHint: Attach a KiCad schematic (.kicad_sch, KiCad 6 or newer), a legacy KiCad .sch or an EAGLE .sch. Hierarchical sheets and symbol libraries are read only from the same folder as the schematic you pick, so keep them together.
workspace.unreadable.missing: The file was not found at its remembered location ({path}). Relink it to the same file, or remove it from the workspace.
workspace.unreadable.located: The file could not be read: {detail} Relink it, or remove it from the workspace.
workspace.unreadable.bare: The file could not be read. Relink it, or remove it from the workspace.
workspace.unreadable.open: {detail} Relink it, or remove it from the workspace.
workspace.unreadable.plain: The file could not be read.
workspace.unreadable.changedFile: The changed file could not be read.
workspace.changed.file: The file at {path} has different content than the one that was attached. Accept the changed file to use it, or relink the original.
workspace.locate.failed: The document could not be located: {detail}
workspace.locate.plain: The documents could not be located.
workspace.locate.attached: The attached documents could not be located.
workspace.changed.accepted: Now using the changed file for "{name}". Bookmarks and annotations were kept; a calibration was cleared.
